name: RustGPT_Bench_100_Unique_Repo
description: A code benchmark sourced from 100 unique Rust repositories designed to evaluate models on Rust code generation, completion, and repository-level coding tasks (e.g., generating functions, fixing bugs, or passing unit tests). It measures a model's practical code-writing and repair abilities in the Rust ecosystem across diverse real-world codebases.
evaluation_method: pass@k (execution-based pass rate) / exact_match for snippet-level checks
reputation: A focused community benchmark for Rust code modeling with modest adoption among code-generation researchers interested in Rust.
